parties.petitioner: Nirmiti Developers Through Its Partners & Anr.

summary: Land reservation under MRTP Act; de-reservation under Section 49 vs Section 127; purchaser cannot claim benefit of prior owner's Section 49 notice; Section 49 for personal hardship, not commercial advantage; subsequent sale after lapse does not vest rights in developer; no steps taken by purchaser under Section 49 or 127; High Court's refusal to declare lapse upheld; liberty to pursue lawful remedies maintained.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 s.49
Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 s.127
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of on the basis of High Court's reasoning; no interference with impugned order; liberty to take lawful steps affirmed.
